{"notes": "Visit 5, left at 10:00. Only what I saw and heard; I still don't know who placed which domino.

Picture: unchanged. One unbroken dark chain from START (~28,4) along the top to the nose (~4.5,11), back along the bottom to the tail tip (~27,15.3). No pale pieces, gaps or strays; nose joint intact. Finished and fully connected. No hands on it.

Omar: Again 'hands off' at 9:45 (said 9:30 too). Consistent with leaving a finished fish alone, but no new work or check seen. Real contributions remain the verified tail extension and the nose-joint warning. Solid on execution, collaboration, impact. Leadership limited to calling the stop.

Sofia: Spoke this time: 'Go fish go! Hands off, everyone.' Just echoing Omar, no new content. Earlier she cleared the three nose strays without breaking the joint and handed the tail to Omar cleanly. Whole-fish check never seen. Still solid, no concerns. Still unclear what Jack's earlier 'sounds good, Sofia' referred to; ask her.

Jack: Only cheerleading again ('Go, little fish, go! Great work, Sofia and Omar'). Praised others, which is pleasant but not output. Five visits, no verified work. Execution and impact unrated; don't rate on cheerleading. Ask him directly what he built or checked.

Hana: Silent all five visits. Nothing seen, no basis for any rating. Ask her directly.

Before final ratings: ask each person privately who built what, who inspected the whole fish, and who found the tail shortfall. Don't rate Jack or Hana on cheerleading or the finished fish alone. Base Omar and Sofia on verified work, and don't inflate leadership for either."}
